mapper.sql: landed_cost_types.id AS id, landed_cost_types.name AS `name`, landed_cost_types.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, landed_cost_types.created AS created, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy, landed_cost_types.modified AS modified

FROM landed_cost_types LEFT JOIN companies ON landed_cost_types.company_id = companies.id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = landed_cost_types.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = landed_cost_types.modified_by

WHERE landed_cost_types.is_active = 1
AND landed_cost_types.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO landed_cost_types ( company_id, `name`, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{landedCostType.companyId}, #{landedCostType.name}, NOW(), #{landedCostType.createdBy}, #{landedCostType.isActive} )
